entries.707357b46f8b4cbf: Its strength is that it can manufacture and sell in-house a lineup of hot-water supply and air-conditioning products spanning heat sources including oil, gas, electricity, solar heat and geothermal heat pumps. Building on the combustion and air-conditioning technologies cultivated since its founding in 1954, 127 research and development staff (10.8% of total employees) develop products under the themes of “people-friendly” and “environment-friendly,” and have created new products such as the industry-first hot-water heater equipped with ultrafine bubbles.

entries.c5faf3a55bd2a29c: Its management philosophy is: “The company constantly strives to create better products and widely disseminate them, thereby contributing to the improvement of social culture.” Under the motto “Customer satisfaction first,” it sets improving customer satisfaction and continuing stable dividends as its management goals. Toward achieving carbon neutrality, it is working to strengthen its lineup of environmentally friendly, high-efficiency products and increase its market share, and will proceed with further increasing share of heat pump and high-efficiency products, developing new customers in overseas sales, and developing high-value-added products that pursue high efficiency, energy savings, comfort and health.

entries.d4a762ca92464b8f: The company is a single segment in the manufacture and sale of housing-related equipment, and by product category, hot-water supply equipment is the largest (sales results for the fiscal year ended December 2025 of ¥21,539 million). In the construction industry, which has close ties to demand, a tough market environment continued amid rising construction costs due to higher building materials and labor costs and expectations of rising housing loan interest rates. Against this backdrop, the company’s revenue was maintained at a slight increase, to ¥46,501 million (up 0.8% year on year). The housing renovation market is expected to remain firm, supported by favorable government subsidy programs.
